rationale: WOLD's Swahili vocabulary is standard Swahili (Schadeberg), Wiktionary's sw.
WOLD's Kanuri vocabulary (Löhr, Wolff and Awagana) is Central Kanuri, which Wiktionary files under kr, Kanuri.
WOLD's Malagasy is Plateau (Merina) Malagasy, on which standard Malagasy rests; Wiktionary's mg, as for the ACD.
Imbabura Quichua is one Quechua variety; Wiktionary has no code for it and files Quechua under qu.
